[EN] They're saying the devan brigands are building their hideout somewhere around here.

Be careful.
[ES] Dicen que los bandidos devan están construyendo su escondite por aquí.

Ten cuidado.

[EN] I hope my sister can find peace.
[ES] Espero que mi hermana pueda encontrar la paz.

[EN] I feel better. Finally.
[ES] Me siento mejor. Por fin.
